Title: Fishing Tournament!
Descriptions: Iiiiit's tiiiiime for the First Annual Kamyshovo Fishing Tournament! Step right up if you're a contestant! The timer starts when you're ready!
Catch one of the following rare saltwater fish: Blue Marlin, Leopard Shark, Jellyfish, Angel Shark, Sail Fish, or Great White Shark. If you die you forfeit your place in the tournament.
Return to the Kamyshovo Marina Bulletin Board for a reward!
